technical_and_design_decisions: All code and configuration changes will be compatible with the Spring XD 1.1.0.BUILD-SNAPSHOT codebase and adhere to the project's existing coding and logging standards, with no breaking changes to public APIs.

For Kafka test modifications (U4, U6), Testcontainers will be used to manage standalone Kafka process lifecycle and external broker provisioning to ensure test reproducibility and avoid manual environment setup.
The publish-maven.gradle script update (U5) will reuse the existing project-wide dependencies.properties file for version management, with no new dependency management tooling introduced.
The log date format added for U3 will follow the existing logging pattern standard used across all Spring XD components to maintain consistency.

The Spark batch job sample (U8) will use Scala 2.12, which is compatible with Spring XD's supported JVM and Scala versions, and will demonstrate a standard word count use case for distributed data processing.

SonarQube violation triage (U7) will follow the project's existing quality profile, with critical and major violations fixed first, and minor issues marked as 'won't fix' only if they are confirmed false positives or out of scope.
assumptions: The Spring XD 1.1.0.BUILD-SNAPSHOT codebase is fully accessible, and all required dependencies (Kafka, Spark, Testcontainers, etc.) are available in the project's internal artifact repositories.
The project's existing dependencies.properties file already contains valid version entries for Spring Boot and hadoop-common as referenced in U5.
The project's wiki platform supports markdown editing and the developer has appropriate permissions to update the Troubleshooting section.
A running external Kafka broker is available for testing U6, or Testcontainers can be used to provision a temporary external broker instance for test validation.
The project's SonarQube instance is accessible and has up-to-date analysis results for the current codebase.
The project's existing samples directory is available for adding the new Spark batch job sample, with appropriate permissions to update documentation.

activities.activity_name: Enable easy deployment of Scala Spark Streaming modules
activities.activity_description: Create deployment documentation and pre-configured templates for Scala-developed Spark Streaming modules, validate that a sample Spark Streaming module can be deployed to a Spring XD distributed setup with minimal custom configuration required by the developer.

activities.activity_name: Update project wiki with ulimit troubleshooting guidance
activities.activity_description: Add a new 'Troubleshooting' section to the project wiki, document the recommended 10K ulimit setting for XD distributed deployments, and include the provided IllegalStateException (Too many open files) as the justification for increasing the ulimit value.

activities.activity_name: Add date field to XD container log configuration
activities.activity_description: Modify the config/xd-container-logger.properties file to include the date field in the log pattern as specified, validate that log output includes the correct date format for troubleshooting without breaking existing log functionality.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Kafka tests to use separate running Kafka process
activities.activity_description: Refactor existing embedded Kafka test setup to launch Kafka as a standalone separate process during test execution, update test configuration to connect to the separate process, and validate all existing Kafka tests pass with the new setup.

activities.activity_name: Update publish-maven.gradle to use centralized dependency versions
activities.activity_description: Modify the publish-maven.gradle script to read dependency versions (e.g. Spring Boot, hadoop-common) from the project's existing dependencies.properties file instead of hardcoded values, validate the script functions correctly for artifact publishing.

activities.activity_name: Add external Kafka broker support to Kafka tests
activities.activity_description: Add configuration options to Kafka tests to allow connecting to an external running Kafka broker instead of the local separate process, update test documentation to explain external broker test execution, and validate tests run successfully against an external broker instance.

Pull current SonarQube analysis results for the codebase, categorize violations as relevant (to fix) or irrelevant (to mark as invalid/won't fix), fix all relevant critical and major violations, and update SonarQube to mark irrelevant issues as false positives.

activities.activity_name: Build Spark batch job sample for distributed computation demonstration
activities.activity_description: Develop a simple Scala-based Spark batch job sample (e.g. word count) compatible with Spring XD, add deployment instructions to the project's samples documentation, and validate the sample runs correctly in a distributed XD setup.
